WITH Sume AS
(
    SELECT 'BCR' AS CodBanca, Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaBCR
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'BRD', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaBRD
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'BT', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaBT
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CEC', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaCEC
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ING', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaING
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'MIL', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaMIL
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RZB', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaRZB
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'UNI', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaUNI
    WHERE Status = 2
)

INSERT INTO app.BancaFisierTransfer
(
    IdCentr,
    CodSucursala,
    Anul,
    Luna,
    CodBanca,
    DenumireBanca,
    EmailDestinatar,
    MesajTransmitere,
    DataPlatii,
    TipPlata,
    DenumireFisier,
    NumarSalariati,
    ValoareTotala,
    Status,
    CreatedDate
    
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER
    (
     ORDER BY
            CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE),
            bc.CodBanca,
            s.TipPlata
    ) AS IdCentr,

    s.CodSucursala,
    s.Anul,
    s.Luna,

    bc.CodBanca,
    bc.DenumireBanca,
    bc.EmailCNPR,
    '' AS MesajTransmitere,

   CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE) AS DataPlatii,

    s.TipPlata,
    s.DenumireFisier,

    COUNT(*) AS NumarSalariati,

    SUM(ISNULL(s.Suma,0)) AS ValoareTotala,

    1 AS Status,
    GETDATE() AS CreatedDate

FROM Sume s

INNER JOIN app.BancaCard bc
    ON bc.CodBanca = s.CodBanca

WHERE s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  AND s.Luna         = @Luna
  AND s.Anul         = @Anul

  AND NOT EXISTS
(
    SELECT 1
    FROM app.BancaFisierTransfer bft
    WHERE bft.CodSucursala = s.CodSucursala
      AND bft.Anul         = s.Anul
      AND bft.Luna         = s.Luna
      AND bft.CodBanca     = bc.CodBanca
      AND bft.TipPlata     = s.TipPlata
      AND bft.DataPlatii   = CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE)
)
  AND (
        TRY_CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE) IS NULL
        OR CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE) = TRY_CAST(@DataPlatii AS DATE)
      )
  AND (
        @TipPlata IS NULL
        OR @TipPlata = ''
        OR s.TipPlata = @TipPlata
      )
GROUP BY
    s.CodSucursala,
    s.Anul,
    s.Luna,
    bc.CodBanca,
    bc.DenumireBanca,
    bc.EmailCNPR,
    s.DenumireFisier,
    CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE),
    s.TipPlata;

UPDATE app.SumaBCR
SET Status = 5
WHERE Status = 2
  AND Anul = @Anul
  AND Luna = @Luna
  AND CodSucursala = @CodSucursala

  AND TipPlata = @TipPlata;
